root_idea.summary: The root centers on the gathering or consolidation of something into a formed whole, especially a bodily or material whole.
root_idea.development: From the notion of aggregation, the evidence develops the noun for an embodied or material body and related extensions for bodily size, corporeity, embodiment, direction toward a target, and undertaking the bulk of an affair.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The group is Quran-attested as the noun جِسْم, with singular and plural surface forms; the singular is the appropriate dictionary headword.

senses.definition: A physical body or corporeal form: the outward bodily frame or physique.
senses.usage_conditions: The lexical discussion characterizes a body as an extended bodily whole with length, breadth, and depth, whose parts remain bodily entities when divided. In the Quranic occurrences, the word is used concretely for bodily physique or bodies, including impressive outward bodily form rather than inner worth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become great, large, bulky, or corpulent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I verb describing a change or state of bodily size, and sometimes the size of a thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become corporeal or bodied.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I bodily or material-state usage distinct from the descriptions of size.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or render corporeal, solid, or possessed of spatial dimensions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II; the cited explanation includes making something have length, breadth, and thickness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or render great, large, big, or bulky.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II causative usage concerning size or bulk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To assume a form or shape, or become an embodiment of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form V usage, including the embodiment of a quality such as generosity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To single out and choose a target from a group, directing one's course or aim toward it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited constructions apply this to selecting a person from a people or tribe and to choosing an animal from a herd; the animal example includes choosing it for slaughter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To head toward a land or country, or to mount or ascend much of a tract of sand or a mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V directional or traversing usage; the supplied evidence marks some applications as figurative or assumed figurative.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To undertake the main or bulk of an affair, especially despite difficulty, trouble, or inconvenience.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V construction for imposing an arduous task upon oneself or venturing into its principal part.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In technical usage, a material substance or solid having length, breadth, and thickness; by extension, a classified natural or celestial material body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The technical terminology includes divisible bodies and classifications such as elements, minerals, plants, and animals, as well as a specialized occult usage for celestial bodies and the elemental constituents.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To regain flesh, good bodily condition, or health after leanness or wasting, in the construction ثاب جسمه or ثاب إليه جسمه.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression describing the return of bodily well-being.
An adjectival derivative referring to the body or to corporeity.
A noun denoting the condition or quality of being bodily or corporeal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Great, large, big, bulky, or corpulent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective of size or bodily bulk; the comparative أَجْسَمُ is subsumed here.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Great or major, especially the bulk, main, principal, or chief part of an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative usage in expressions concerning great affairs, events, or calamities and the principal part of an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Intelligent men, in a figurative plural usage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested specifically for the plural جُسُمٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Elevated land over which water has risen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use, with جِسَامٌ given as its plural.

cautions: The Quranic group is presented under the singular dictionary headword جِسْم, although one occurrence is the plural أَجْسَامُ.
The Quranic evidence supports concrete bodily or physical usage; technical classifications of material bodies are kept under broader Classical Arabic meanings.
